thread:
marta: FYI opened a docs PR to soften SOC2 retention wording and refresh audit-export SDK/curl samples: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/823
pranav: Are we changing policy text or just examples?
marta: Both. Legal wants softer phrasing and a note about legal holds. Examples need a small redaction snippet and a CLI flag fix.
kelly: noted a flag mismatch in the curl sample (using --ttl). Should be --retention-days. Also avoid asserting a single retention default.
olivia-legal: please replace any line like 'we retain audit logs for 90 days' with: 'we retain audit logs according to customer configuration and applicable legal requirements (typical retention ranges: 30-365 days).' Add sentence: 'Customers are responsible for setting retention to meet their obligations; legal holds may override configured TTLs.'
pranav: can we include a short illustrative SDK snippet showing export-time redaction?
marta: added this python example and marked it illustrative:
```
# illustrative only
from redwood import AuditExport
exp = AuditExport(api_key=REDWOOD_API_KEY)
exp.export(filter={"redact": ["email"]}, retention_days=90)
```
ci-bot: docs CI passed (link-check OK) for PR #823 :white_check_mark:
kelly: added small note about scope: export-time redaction differs from platform-level masking.
olivia-legal: wording approved.
marta: thanks all, will merge after pranav's quick eng pass and add a changelog entry.
summary: Short coordination thread for docs PR updating SOC2/retention wording and audit-export examples; legal requested softer language and a illustrative redaction snippet; CLI flag corrected and CI passed; awaiting final engineering review.
